exportDialog.contrast.title: Low contrast between code and background
exportDialog.contrast.detail: Contrast is {{ratio}}:1. Phone cameras need at least 4.5:1 for reliable decoding.
exportDialog.contrast.fix: Darken the dots or lighten the background until contrast reaches at least 4.5:1.
exportDialog.inverted.title: Inverted code with limited contrast
exportDialog.inverted.detail: Light dots on a dark background at this contrast may confuse older scanners.
exportDialog.inverted.fix: Swap the colors so the dots are darker than the background.
exportDialog.quiet-zone.title: Quiet zone around finder patterns is too small
exportDialog.quiet-zone.detail: Scanners need 4 clear modules around the code to recognize the three corner squares.
exportDialog.quiet-zone.fix: Increase the margin to at least 4 blank modules on every side.
exportDialog.logo.title: Logo covers too much of the code
exportDialog.logo.detail: Error correction recovers about 30%, but not in the corner squares.
exportDialog.logo.fix: Reduce the logo to at most 25% of the code.
exportDialog.density.title: Very dense matrix
exportDialog.density.detail: This QR code contains {{length}} characters; individual modules become very small.
exportDialog.density.fix: Shorten the content or use a dynamic short link.
exportDialog.print-size.title: Print size is too small for this amount of data
exportDialog.print-size.detail: This code density requires at least {{mm}} mm to remain readable.
exportDialog.print-size.fix: Increase print size to at least {{mm}} mm.
stepUp.cardDescription: Your ROUT card is protected. Confirm with one of your active methods. The confirmation works for one action and expires after 2 minutes.
stepUp.needTwoFactor: Turn on two-step verification first (passkey, authenticator app or SMS) in your account settings.
stepUp.cardTapHint: Hold your ROUT Card against your phone.
stepUp.cardScanning: Hold the card against the back of this phone now…
stepUp.cardOtherDeviceNfc: Scanning not working? Just hold the card against your phone, open the notification and tap “Yes, I confirm”. This screen then continues on its own.
stepUp.cardOtherDevice: On iPhone: hold the card near the top of your phone, tap the notification, then “Yes, I confirm”. On a computer: use a phone signed in to this account. This screen then continues on its own.
stepUp.cardDenied: This card was not accepted. Use your own active ROUT Card and tap again.
stepUp.cardUnreadable: That was not a ROUT Card tap. Hold your ROUT Card against the phone.
stepUp.cardUnavailable: You have no active ROUT Card you can use for this.
stepUp.cardLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
stepUp.cardNfcBlocked: NFC could not start. Turn NFC on and allow the browser, or just hold the card against your phone.
console.billing.title: Billing & usage
console.billing.description: What your integrations cost, which limits apply and what we expect from usage.
console.billing.planName: Developer access without a billing account
console.billing.planText: Apps, Login with ROUT, API keys, webhooks and MCP connectors need no billing account today. If paid features are ever added, you will see them here first and choose whether to use them.
console.billing.limitAuthorize: Authorization requests: {{n}} per minute per account.
console.billing.limitsText: When an API request goes over a limit, you get a 429 with a Retry-After header. Wait that many seconds before trying again.
console.billing.fairUseText: Use the API for genuine integrations and automation. On excessive load, scraping or suspicious traffic, ROUT can throttle, suspend or revoke access immediately.
admin.forbidden.title: No access to administration
admin.forbidden.body: This part of ROUT is for administrators only. Your account has no admin rights.
cardTap.confirm.title: Confirm with your ROUT Card?
cardTap.confirm.body: A request is waiting for confirmation with your ROUT Card. Only confirm if you just started that action yourself, on this device or on another screen.
cardTap.declined.title: Nothing confirmed
cardTap.declined.body: The request expires on its own within 5 minutes. Didn't you ask for this yourself? Check the active sessions in your account and sign out unknown devices.
cardTap.handoff.title: Card handed over
cardTap.handoff.setup: Your other window is setting up your recovery vault and asks for this card as the fourth piece.
cardTap.handoff.restore: Your other window is restoring your master key and asks for this card as one of the two pieces.
cardTap.handoff.login: Your other window is signing you in by recovery and asks for this card as one of the two pieces.
cardTap.handoff.private: The card secret goes encrypted, straight to that window in this browser. It never leaves your device, not even to ROUT.
cardTap.handoff.sent.title: Card handed over
cardTap.handoff.sent.body: Go back to your other window to continue. You can close this window.
cardTap.handoff.failed.title: Card not handed over
cardTap.handoff.failed.body: Your other window is no longer waiting or could not open the card. Start the step there again, then tap your card.
cardTap.handoff.many.title: Several windows are waiting for your card
cardTap.handoff.many.body: Close the other windows with a recovery step so the card is sure to reach the right one. Then tap again.
cardTap.handoff.declined.title: Not handed over
cardTap.handoff.declined.body: The card secret has been wiped from this window.
cardTap.activate.title: Activate your ROUT Card
cardTap.activate.body: This card will be linked to the account you're signed in with. If your card came with an activation code, enter it.
cardTap.activated.title: Your ROUT Card is active
cardTap.activated.body: The card is now linked to your account.
cardTap.wait.title: Please wait
cardTap.activateLimited.body: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again later.
cardTap.activateFailed.title: Not linked
cardTap.activateFailed.body: This card could not be linked. Are you signed in, is the card not linked yet, and is the code correct? Start again from your account and tap the card again.
cardTap.verified.body: The chip just proved with its own secret key that it is genuine. This tap works once: a copied link will not work again.
cardTap.verified.unlinked: This card is not linked to a member yet.
cardTap.stepUpConfirmed.title: Confirmed with your ROUT Card
cardTap.stepUpConfirmed.body: Go back to the screen that asked for confirmation. It will continue there on its own.
cardTap.notConfirmed.title: Not confirmed
cardTap.stepUpDenied.body: This tap could not complete your confirmation. Use your own active ROUT Card, hold it against your phone again, or start over if the time has run out.
cardTap.tapLimited.body: Too many checks in a short time. Try again in a moment.
cardTap.missing.body: Open this page by holding your ROUT Card against your phone.
cardTap.denied.body: This tap could not be confirmed. Hold the card against your phone again; a copied or old link never works.
cardTap.verified.title: Authentic ROUT Card
cardTap.handoff.body: Your ROUT Card was passed, encrypted, to your recovery vault. Go back to that tab to continue. You can close this tab.
cardTap.handoff.failed: Your card could not be passed to your recovery vault. Go back to that tab and tap your card again.
cardTap.handoff.denied: This is not your own, active ROUT Card. Your recovery vault can only be set up with your own card.
